summary: Iteration 6 — Employee-facing workspace + RBAC + manager→employee round-trip fully verified on BOTH backend and frontend. Backend (9/9 in test_employee_workspace.py): employee 403 on /performance/team + /audit; /performance/me returns self KPIs (all 10 KPI fields present); /leads scoped strictly to leads where employee is owner/followup_assigned_to/demo_owner (priya sees only 3 involved leads); /tasks scoped to assignee/assigner; manager /performance/team returns rows for all 5 seeded members incl. employee/intern; manager /audit + admin dashboards 200; full round-trip: manager POST /leads/{id}/handover (responsibility=follow_up, assignee=priya) → task created for priya + notification received (unread count +1) + timeline includes handover event → priya PATCH /tasks/{id} status=Completed → timeline gains a 'complet…' event and manager gets a task completion notification. Frontend (Playwright, viewport 1440x900): OTP login works for priya/paripsa/admin. Priya lands on employee-dashboard, my-kpis renders all 10 tiles (kpi-leads-added, kpi-contacted, kpi-responses, kpi-interested, kpi-demos-booked, kpi-demos-done, kpi-followups, kpi-conversions, kpi-tasks-done, kpi-overdue), 3 my-task-* items visible with complete-task-<id> Done buttons, notification-bell visible, sidebar HIDES nav-all-leads and nav-team-performance for employee while nav-my-leads is present. Direct navigation to /all-leads and /team-performance as employee redirects to /dashboard (client guard confirmed). Clicking Done on a seeded task removes the task from the dashboard list (server confirmed completion). Manager (paripsa) has nav-team-performance and TeamPerformance page renders Priya, Arjun and Neha rows. Admin dashboard renders. My Leads table shows exactly 3 rows for priya (matches backend scoping). Reason enforcement UI (lost-reason-modal + confirm-lost-btn disabled) was already comprehensively validated in iteration_5 and not re-run here; backend still enforces reasons for Not Interested/Lost per iteration_5 tests. Regression: Demos.jsx member filter fix (legacy 'member' → active roles) confirmed via manager Team Performance listing all roles.

issues: Dev OTP is displayed in an amber banner on the login screen. Acceptable per problem statement (OTP_DEV_MODE=true) but MUST be gated off before production.

action_items: (Prod-hardening) Before production, disable OTP_DEV_MODE and ensure /api/auth/request-otp response no longer includes dev_otp field.
(Optional) Modularize /app/backend/server.py (~1360 lines) into feature modules (auth, leads, handover, tasks, notifications, performance, audit).

(A11y / Design carry-overs from iter 5) Replace native date/time inputs in Tasks New Task dialog with shadcn Calendar/TimePicker; add DialogTitle + aria-describedby to Handover/LostReason/NewTask dialogs to silence Radix warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is monolithic (~1360 lines); refactor recommended before further feature growth.
handover() still writes a self-notification when a manager assigns a lead to themselves; consider skipping self-notification (also flagged in iter 5).
Timeline for 'requires_reason' status changes shows only 'changed status from X to Y' — appending the actual lost_reason would make the timeline more auditable.
seed_demo.py force-activates seeded users on every run — if an admin deactivates one, next seed silently re-enables them.

/api/users is intentionally readable by employees so assignee dropdowns work — this is a documented design decision, not a permission bug, but consider trimming the payload to (id, name, role, active) for non-managers to minimize data exposure.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of employee-workspace + manager + admin flows exercised

test_credentials: OTP dev-mode via POST /api/auth/request-otp -> dev_otp (also on login screen). admin@beet.health / paripsa.tripathi@beet.health / priya@beet.health / arjun@beet.health / neha@beet.health.
seed_data_creation: Reused existing seed (python /app/backend/seed_demo.py). Test creates one handover task on priya (leaves task in Completed state).
context_for_next_testing_agent: OTP rate-limit is 5 requests / 10 min per email — if you hit 429, run `python -c "from pymongo import MongoClient; MongoClient('mongodb://localhost:27017').test_database.otps.delete_many({})"` to clear. Run pytest with `-o addopts=''` to avoid inheriting pytest-xdist args from pytest.ini for isolated files. All employee-facing testids are stable: employee-dashboard, my-kpis, kpi-*, my-task-*, complete-task-<id>, my-followup-*, my-demo-*, my-activity-*, notification-bell, nav-my-leads. To open a lead drawer in table, click the FIRST cell (lead name).
rca of the issue: N/A — no failures. All acceptance criteria in the review_request satisfied on both backend and UI.
